title: Scaffold Vite React TypeScript Phaser app, scripts for typecheck lint test build, basic tests
notes: Scaffolded client-only Vite/React/TypeScript/Phaser app with pinned dependencies, lifecycle-safe Phaser host, ESLint and Vitest setup. Verified npm run typecheck, lint, test (2 passing), and build on 2026-11-14.

title: Implement original crayon design system and homepage responsive layout
notes: Implemented an original responsive crayon homepage and reusable local SVG/CSS design primitives with accessible contrast, focus states, reduced-motion handling, and honest coming-soon states. Verified npm run typecheck, lint, test (3 passing), and build on 2026-11-14.

title: Add all 32 catalog entries and browse/details/coming-soon navigation
notes: Added the exact ordered 32-game catalog, responsive searchable/filterable browse UI, hash-based home/catalog/detail navigation, procedural local artwork, and honest Coming soon/disabled-start states for every unvalidated game. Verified npm run typecheck, lint, test (5 passing), and build on 2026-11-14.

title: Camera permissions, device selection, mirrored preview, lifecycle and error states
notes: Added an isolated browser-native CameraSource and responsive setup flow with interaction-gated permission, device selection/restart, mirrored preview, track-end disconnect recovery, actionable permission/missing/busy/unsupported errors, simulation mode, and stream cleanup on navigation. Verified npm run typecheck, lint, test (10 passing), and build on 2026-11-14. Physical webcam behavior remains unverified and requires hardware validation.
